🇺🇸 US, Russia, Ukraine to discuss security architecture Jared Kushner announced that the US, Russia, Ukraine, and Europe will hold bilateral and multilateral talks in the coming weeks on a future security framework. Discussions will cover guarantees modelled on NATO Article 5, mutual obligations, and respect for sovereignty. Kushner stressed that Ukrainian security cannot be separated from European post-war architecture. The goal is ensuring Ukraine's safety while confirming Russia does not face NATO confrontation, provided Moscow respects neighbours' sovereignty. Peskov confirmed new trilateral negotiations are imminent but noted no specific dates are set yet. Additionally, the US and Europe plan to develop a long-term economic recovery programme for Ukraine.
